import Curve25519Dalek.Funs
import Curve25519Dalek.Math.Basic
import Curve25519Dalek.Aux

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
open curve25519_dalek

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- One step of the little-endian byte packing: `o = acc ||| ((b as u64) << n)`. -/
theorem from_bytes_loop_or_step {acc w s o : U64} {b : U8} {n : Nat}
    (hw : w = UScalar.cast .U64 b) (hs : s.val = w.val <<< n % U64.size)
    (ho : o.val = (acc ||| s).val) (hacc : acc.val < 2 ^ n) (hn : n + 8 ≤ 64) :
    o.val = acc.val + 2 ^ n * b.val ∧ o.val < 2 ^ (n + 8) := by
  have hb : b.val < 2 ^ 8 := by scalar_tac
  have hwv : w.val = b.val := by
    rw [hw, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by simp [UScalarTy.numBits]; omega)
  have hsz : U64.size = 2 ^ 64 := by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]
  rw [ho, UScalar.val_or, hs, hwv, hsz, Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add hacc hb hn]
  exact ⟨rfl, Nat.add_two_pow_mul_lt hacc hb⟩

/-- If the four 64-bit words are the little-endian packings of consecutive 8-byte chunks,
then their radix-`2^64` value is the little-endian value of the 32 bytes. -/
theorem from_bytes_loop_words_sum (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (r : Array U64 4#usize)
    (h : ∀ j, j < 4 →
      (r.val[j]!).val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * j + k]!).val) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 4, 2 ^ (64 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val = U8x32_as_Nat bytes := by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => by rw [h j (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)])]
  unfold U8x32_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Nat.reduceMul, Nat.reduceAdd]
  ring

/-- Combines the result of one loop iteration (word `i` written) with the result of the
recursive call (words `i+1..4`). -/
theorem from_bytes_loop_post (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (words a r : Array U64 4#usize)
    (i i' : Nat) (o7 : U64) (hi' : i' = i + 1) (hai : a.val[i]! = o7)
    (hane : ∀ j, j ≠ i → a.val[j]! = words.val[j]!)
    (hword : o7.val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * i + k]!).val)
    (hr1 : ∀ j, j < i' → r.val[j]! = a.val[j]!)
    (hr2 : ∀ j, i' ≤ j → j < 4 →
      (r.val[j]!).val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * j + k]!).val) :
    (∀ j, j < i → r.val[j]! = words.val[j]!) ∧
    (∀ j, i ≤ j → j < 4 →
      (r.val[j]!).val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * j + k]!).val) ∧
    (i = 0 →
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 4, 2 ^ (64 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val = U8x32_as_Nat bytes) := by
  subst hi'
  have hall : ∀ j, i ≤ j → j < 4 →
      (r.val[j]!).val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * j + k]!).val := by
    intro j hj1 hj2
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      rw [hr1 j (by omega), hai, hword]
    · exact hr2 j (by omega) hj2
  refine ⟨?_, hall, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    rw [hr1 j (by omega), hane j (by omega)]
  · intro hi0
    exact from_bytes_loop_words_sum bytes r (fun j hj => hall j (by omega) hj)

/-- `from_bytes_loop bytes words i` fills the words `i..4` with the little-endian packing of
the corresponding 8-byte chunks of `bytes`, leaving words `< i` unchanged. Started at `i = 0`
the resulting words encode `U8x32_as_Nat bytes` in radix `2^64`. -/
@[progress]
theorem from_bytes_loop_spec (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (words : Array U64 4#usize)
    (i : Usize) :
    from_bytes_loop bytes words i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.val[j]! = words.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, i.val ≤ j → j < 4 →
        (r.val[j]!).val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 8, 2 ^ (8 * k) * (bytes.val[8 * j + k]!).val) ∧
      (i.val = 0 →
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 4, 2 ^ (64 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val = U8x32_as_Nat bytes) ⦄ := by
  unfold from_bytes_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 4 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨base, hbase⟩
    progress as ⟨b0, hb0⟩
    progress as ⟨w0, hw0⟩
    progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
    progress as ⟨b1, hb1⟩
    progress as ⟨w1, hw1⟩
    progress as ⟨s1, hs1⟩
    progress as ⟨o1, ho1⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨b2, hb2⟩
    progress as ⟨w2, hw2⟩
    progress as ⟨s2, hs2⟩
    progress as ⟨o2, ho2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3⟩
    progress as ⟨b3, hb3⟩
    progress as ⟨w3, hw3⟩
    progress as ⟨s3, hs3⟩
    progress as ⟨o3, ho3⟩

/-- Proven (sorry-free) specification of `conditional_select` on `u64`, used locally. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `conditional_add_l_loop`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- `conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i` adds (if `condition` is set) the
limbs `i..4` of `L` to the limbs `i..4` of `self`, propagating the carry and reducing
every limb modulo `2^52`. Started at `i = 0` with `carry = 0`, the result satisfies
`r.2 + 2^260 * (r.1 / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩

    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩

set_option exponentiation.threshold 260

namespace curve25519_dalek
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Aeneas.Std.WP Result

end curve25519_dalek

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Proven (sorry-free) specification of `conditional_select` on `u64`, used locally. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `conditional_add_l_loop`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- `conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i` adds (if `condition` is set) the
limbs `i..4` of `L` to the limbs `i..4` of `self`, propagating the carry and reducing
every limb modulo `2^52`. Started at `i = 0` with `carry = 0`, the result satisfies
`r.2 + 2^260 * (r.1 / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with conditional_add_l_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    sorry
  · sorry
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals (simp_wf; scalar_tac)
